seoTitle: How to Make a Slideshow on Squarespace Easily
metaDescription: Build a photo slideshow on Squarespace using the image block — set the layout, transitions, autoplay, and mobile display without any coding.
intro: A slideshow is a simple way to showcase a portfolio, gallery, or homepage visuals without cluttering the page. This guide covers adding an image block, choosing a slideshow layout, and tuning transitions and autoplay so it looks good on both desktop and mobile.

steps.heading: Add an image block
steps.body: In the page editor, insert an image block in the section where you want the slideshow to appear.

steps.heading: Choose the slideshow layout
steps.body: Select the slideshow display option from the block's layout choices instead of a static grid or carousel.

steps.heading: Adjust transitions and autoplay
steps.body: Set how images transition between slides and whether the slideshow advances automatically.

steps.heading: Customize style and size
steps.body: Fine-tune the slideshow's dimensions and visual style to match the rest of your page design.

steps.heading: Optimize images and check mobile
steps.body: Compress your images for faster loading, then preview the slideshow on mobile to confirm it displays properly on smaller screens.

faq.question: Do I need a plugin to add a slideshow to Squarespace?
faq.answer: No, the built-in image block includes a slideshow layout option, so no extra plugin is needed.

faq.question: Can I control how fast the slideshow moves?
faq.answer: Yes, the autoplay and transition settings let you adjust the pacing between slides.

faq.question: Will the slideshow look good on mobile?
faq.answer: Squarespace slideshows adapt to mobile, but it's worth previewing on a phone and adjusting settings for the best fit.

faq.question: How can I make my slideshow load faster?
faq.answer: Optimizing your images before uploading — reducing file size while keeping quality — helps the slideshow load quickly.
